SELECT p_user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND p_couple_id IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.profiles AS profile
      JOIN public.couples AS couple ON couple.id = profile.couple_id
      WHERE profile.id = p_user_id
        AND profile.couple_id = p_couple_id
        AND (
          (profile.role = 'bride' AND couple.bride_id = p_user_id)
          OR (profile.role = 'groom' AND couple.groom_id = p_user_id)
        )
    );
dependencies.name: is_current_couple_member
dependencies.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_current_couple_member(p_user_id uuid, p_couple_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
 SET statement_timeout TO '5s'
AS $function$
  SELECT p_user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND p_couple_id IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.profiles AS profile
      JOIN public.couples AS couple ON couple.id = profile.couple_id
      WHERE profile.id = p_user_id
        AND profile.couple_id = p_couple_id
        AND (
          (profile.role = 'bride' AND couple.bride_id = p_user_id)
          OR (profile.role = 'groom' AND couple.groom_id = p_user_id)
        )
    );
$function$
